## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Verification

List the Magento versions, PHP versions, commands, and admin or queue workflows tested.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is generic and contains no customer, store, credential, or local-environment data.
- [ ] Magento Coding Standard and relevant unit tests pass.
- [ ] New behavior includes success, failure, permission, and queue-state coverage where applicable.
- [ ] README and CHANGELOG documentation is updated when required.
- [ ] Cache, compilation, setup, static-content, consumer, and reindex implications are documented.
- [ ] Backward compatibility and multi-node behavior were considered.
